svg.title: EnIGMA Capture The Flag system diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: a left black Capture The Flag challenge card points to a large EnIGMA framework panel. Inside the main panel are the language model, cybersecurity commands, long-output summarizer, LM-friendly commands, SWE-agent computer interfaces, feedback, a computer UI block, and a challenge server, connected by blue, gray, and orange/red arrows. SAM mappings are used for confirmed icon crops while native SVG construction remains present.
